name: Infinite Script Fighting
desc:
Welcome to ISF
Fight with extremely overpowered and chaotic characters also known as scripts

There are 80+ characters currently in the game ( 1x1x1x1, John Doe, Minos Prime ect. )
Fun Fact: Most "Forsaken" characters were made before Forsaken ever came out

⚠️ Do not exploit, you will get banned
